set.body: Use the 2026-10-07 quality report and unrated human-review.csv packet. No independently paired manual landmarks or expert anatomical sign-off currently exists. HOCPA/HOSPA and Schaefer destination labels are dependent mapped references; T2 uses upstream T1-based registration with incomplete HCP construction provenance. Arrange blinded manual paired landmarks/labels in both exact template frames and expert regional review before claiming a ground-truth accuracy bound. Parent bd-01M4AYFGCW290FC4ZGNKZE4PGE.
set.title: Obtain independent anatomical references and expert transform review
